documents.text: Phishing emails often impersonate banks and ask users to verify account credentials on lookalike domains.
Multi-factor authentication reduces account takeover risk when passwords are reused or leaked.
TF-IDF ranks documents by term frequency weighted by inverse document frequency for sparse retrieval.
nDCG and MRR are common ranking metrics used to evaluate information retrieval and RAG systems.
SSH private keys should use mode 600 and the .ssh directory should not be group or world readable.
A secrets scanner searches repositories for API keys, tokens, and high-entropy strings before release.
DNS resolvers in resolv.conf determine where a host sends recursive queries for domain names.
Prompt tracing records LLM messages and tool calls so engineers can debug agent behavior offline.
